chapter: Gabriel's sons, small bands and Detroit
title: Detroit sons and two years at the Parkland Hotel
summary: He says he never stopped playing, mentions his son Charles, and a two-year Dixieland engagement at the Parkland Hotel.

story.theme_name: Making a living: hard times, day jobs and scarce work
story.community_name: Day jobs: musicians working outside music

blocks.x: Yeah. Oh yeah, I'm into music, I never stopped playing. I played with my boy, my boy's got a contract he signed up for here in Portland, Orphan. Charles Gabriel, my little boy's playing the Orphan over there. But anyhow, that's the job that I have there. Now we played all over, we played at the Parkland Hotel for two years. Two years we played at Parkland Hotel. I think I showed you that, didn't I?
Oh yeah. Two years we played at Parkland, supposed to play two weeks, and I broke them in on the Dixieland because they wanted Dixieland. Then the man said it would be something different.
